(iii) Equity price risk
The investments are unquoted and there is no readily available market for valuation.
(d) Capital management
The Board’s policy is to maintain a strong capital base so as to maintain investor, creditor and market confidence and to sustain future
development of the business. The Board of Directors monitors the return on capital, which the Group defines as total shareholders’
equity.
There were no changes in the Group’s approach to capital management during the year. The Group is not subject to externally
imposed capital requirements
(e) Fair value
The fair values of significant financial assets and liabilities is the same as the carrying amounts as shown in the balance sheet.
